messages:
Lena Morales: Thanks for the great all-hands. A few quick follow-ups from a customer-facing thread about SOC2/ISO and KMS/VPC: can leadership confirm timelines and the artifacts we promise in RFP responses? Pinging @Vikram and @Emily for specifics.

Vikram Rao: TL;DR: BYOK cross-account support -> Dedicated pilot Q3; GA Q4. Private (VPC/on-prem) adapter in early Q1 next year. Key rotation/rollover automation -> staging Q4, GA Q1. Audit export hooks (S3/Syslog/Kafka) -> connector beta Q4.

Emily Nguyen: For compliance deliverables in RFPs: we provide SOC2 Type II attestation (when available), ISO-27001 certificate, control mapping matrix (CSV), and a per-customer evidence bundle for Dedicated/Private customers containing KMS policies, IAM role bindings, VPC peering/VPN configs, and audit log extracts. Evidence-bundle export via Console targeted for beta by end of Q4.

Jess Ortega: Implementation note: BYOK flow will use a challenge-response model (we never take private key material). For Dedicated: customers can register a key ARN from their KMS account and we validate signatures. For Private: the same pattern but the adapter uses customer-side connectors. Docs draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/byok-patterns (will post updates).

Carlos Duarte: RFP checklist request: customers often ask for retention and chain-of-custody for logs. Current hosting retention: 90 days indexed, raw S3 cold storage 1 year by default; Dedicated customers can opt to export and retain up to 5 years. We'll add a clear table in the RFP appendix.

Lena Morales: Helpful. One specific ask: can we promise S3 push with server-side encryption using the customer's key?

Vikram Rao: Yes — S3 export will support SSE-KMS where the bucket is encrypted with the customer's key. For direct push into a customer-owned bucket we will assume roles and write with customer-defined encryption headers. We'll document the required trust policy.

Emily Nguyen: Also note: for attestations we cannot promise SOC2 reporting on a per-customer cadence; we deliver the company-wide SOC2 report and the per-customer evidence bundle (configs, logs, policies). For continuous evidence integrations (e.g., a SIEM), we can supply a streaming export via Kafka or S3 which customers can ingest into their pipeline as an add-on.

Jess Ortega: Small example S3 export IAM role snippet for customers to include in their account (docs will include this):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT:role/redwood-writer" },
      "Action": "s3:PutObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::customer-audit-bucket/*",
      "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms" } }
    }
  ]
}
```

Ops Bot: Roadmap doc updated: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/kms-vpc-evidence | Office hours: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours (slots next Tue/Thu).

Carlos Duarte: One more practical RFP detail: customers sometimes require export of immutable audit trails for 2+ years. We should include an option template and cost estimate. Suggest adding a pricing table in the RFP appendix.

Vikram Rao: Agreed. Action items: 1) Publish BYOK pilot sign-up + PRD (me, this week) 2) Draft evidence-bundle sample for RFP appendix (Emily/Jess, next Tue) 3) Add S3/Kafka connector spec and IAM snippets (Jess/Carlos) 4) Add retention/pricing table (Carlos). I'll follow up with dates here.

Lena Morales: Thanks — please @mention this thread when PRD and the RFP appendix are live. Will route to the customer. :white_check_mark:

Emily Nguyen: I'll also attach the control mapping CSV and a short note on how customers can map our controls to their own scope.

Jess Ortega: Will post a first PRD draft by EOD Friday and link it here.

Ops Bot: Reminder: compliance office hours booked — first slot tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Vikram Rao: Closing note: we need to be careful with wording in RFPs around "separation of key material" and "access guarantees" — legal and security are final sign-off. I'll loop in Security for copy review.

Lena Morales: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
